provenance.attention_scope: Unsigned learned fake-hypothesis proposal, shared by eight sampled frames; not a manipulation probability or GAT attention coefficient.

provenance.contribution_scope: Signed classifier readouts for an adjacent sampled pair; no source-pixel causality claim. Shared scale across branches and pairs within a clip.

provenance.scope: Curated correctly classified clips. K7 validation applies only to the listed clips and selected K7 regions.
provenance.score_scope: Validation-calibrated detector score; score_real is its complement, not an independent calibrated measurement.
provenance.spectral_scope: Auxiliary sigmoid-filtered raw-pixel display of frame A; graph frequency, not image FFT. The detector filters learned features with the raw response and a residual.

analysis_sections.text: The middle displayed pair contains strong positive readouts in central facial grid cells. Other sampled pairs redistribute that support, so the map should be read for the currently selected pair. analysis_sections.text: The purple map places substantial importance across the central face, with the connected selection covering a compact part of that focus. Its extent is broader than some contribution peaks. A separate explanation head produces these unsigned scores from frozen detector features; it does not supply the weights used by the original classifier. The map is shared across the sampled frames of each clip.
analysis_sections.title: The explanation head’s proposed focus

analysis_sections.text: Hiding the selected central region reduces the fake-minus-real margin, while restoring it into the reference image recovers fake support. The recorded whole-curve comparisons favor the candidate over the displayed strongest controls under both replacement methods and control families. Together with the recorded stability checks, this supports model reliance on the selected region. It does not establish the exact pixels edited in the source video.

report.conclusion: The detector’s output and regional reliance indicate manipulation, despite absence of visible artifacts in the original frames.

diagnosis.evidence_synthesis: No visual manipulation cues were observed in the original crops or frame sequences.
